## v0.2.0

### Changes by Kind

#### Feature

- Added SSH Git access for model repositories with public-key authentication, automatic model registration during clone and push, and configurable SSH port exposure for Docker Compose and Helm deployments. ([#697](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/697), [@setsunakute](https://github.com/setsunakute))

- The registry management UI now supports creating and managing MatrixHub-type registries. ([#710](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/710), [@lsq645599166](https://github.com/lsq645599166))

- Prepare config.yaml in the same folder with docker-compose.yml to make docker compose setup steps easier ([#814](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/814), [@yitingdc](https://github.com/yitingdc))

- refactor(chart): use StatefulSet for MySQL with volumeClaimTemplates ([#890](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/890), [@wzshiming](https://github.com/wzshiming))

- Guide users to create a registry when the target registry selector is empty during project creation. ([#957](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/957), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

- Added SQLite support for single-node deployments. Docker Compose now uses SQLite by default, while MySQL remains available through an explicit Compose configuration. Helm/Kubernetes deployments do not support SQLite. ([#962](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/962), [@setsunakute](https://github.com/setsunakute))

- Improve guidance for the Registry Base URL field when creating a registry: provider-specific hints and defaults, a confirmation before overwriting a customized URL on provider switch, and a warning for addresses that look like a specific repository. ([#995](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/995), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

- Add a documentation site link to the header. ([#997](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/997), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

#### Bug or Regression

- Copy buttons now work when MatrixHub is served over HTTP. ([#678](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/678), [@lsq645599166](https://github.com/lsq645599166))

- Robot accounts now enforce disabled and expired states and all-project permissions, while model commits made with robot credentials show the correct uploader. ([#688](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/688), [@setsunakute](https://github.com/setsunakute))

- Long registry names now wrap correctly in the delete confirmation dialog. ([#718](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/718), [@lsq645599166](https://github.com/lsq645599166))

- Project settings now display a success notification after changes are saved. ([#719](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/719), [@lsq645599166](https://github.com/lsq645599166))

- Creating a model now rejects names longer than 251 characters. ([#729](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/729), [@scydas](https://github.com/scydas))

- Model parameter counts are now displayed correctly for single-file safetensors models and sharded models without total-size metadata. ([#739](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/739), [@scydas](https://github.com/scydas))

- Fixed model size display to use repository tree content size instead of Git repository disk usage. ([#759](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/759), [@scydas](https://github.com/scydas))

- Fix Markdown previews to consistently use the light color scheme. ([#761](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/761), [@vivian-xu](https://github.com/vivian-xu))

- Creating a model now rejects invalid names and normalizes model identifiers to avoid detail-page 404s caused by leading or trailing whitespace. ([#781](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/781), [@scydas](https://github.com/scydas))

- Updated Go and quic-go to address known security vulnerabilities. ([#797](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/797), [@scydas](https://github.com/scydas))

- Fixed duplicate-resource error handling and addressed a database dependency vulnerability. ([#803](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/803), [@scydas](https://github.com/scydas))

- Hardened repository listing and authentication against malformed namespace and token inputs. ([#822](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/822), [@setsunakute](https://github.com/setsunakute))

- Hardened model repository listing to prevent author filters from accessing content outside the configured storage directory. ([#830](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/830), [@setsunakute](https://github.com/setsunakute))

- Fix the homepage Quick Start link so it opens the Getting Started guide. ([#880](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/880), [@yitingdc](https://github.com/yitingdc))

- Project member dialogs now explain role permissions and default new members to the Viewer role. ([#887](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/887), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

- Project viewers no longer see the Create Model action, which is now limited to project administrators and editors. ([#900](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/900), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

- Create and edit sync rule dialogs now adapt their layout to the selected language so field labels remain readable. ([#904](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/904), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

- Enlarged the create access token button on the profile page to match other create buttons. ([#907](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/907), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

- Hugging Face registry discovery now uses the configured mirror or proxy URL, and the sync job API now exposes the PENDING status correctly. ([#915](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/915), [@Phil-OSophy-42](https://github.com/Phil-OSophy-42))

- Manually triggered replication runs are now recorded and displayed with the Manual trigger type, even when the policy is scheduled. ([#918](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/918), [@Phil-OSophy-42](https://github.com/Phil-OSophy-42))

- Fixed model creation after a failed upload leaves an existing repository without a database record. ([#930](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/930), [@scydas](https://github.com/scydas))

- Manually specified robot account tokens must now be 8–20 characters and include at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number. ([#937](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/937), [@setsunakute](https://github.com/setsunakute))

- SSH key registration now returns clear errors when a key is already registered or has expired. ([#939](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/939), [@setsunakute](https://github.com/setsunakute))

- Made project selection dropdowns scrollable and searchable, with a clear selected-project indicator. ([#945](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/945), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

- Improved empty model repository guidance and allowed projects to be created directly from the model creation form. ([#947](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/947), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

- Large per-file commit diffs now show an inline raw diff link while the existing 50-file limit remains unchanged. ([#948](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/948), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

- Fixed remote sync reporting success while leaving the model/dataset description, size and labels empty in the database. Dataset sync no longer creates model records instead of dataset records. ([#950](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/950), [@Phil-OSophy-42](https://github.com/Phil-OSophy-42))

- Remove misleading resource name placeholder in replication form- #954 ([#954](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/954), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

- Adds an explanation of the public / private project types, so users understand what each visibility level means before picking one. ([#956](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/956), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

- make table columns fit and keep row actions reachable. ([#958](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/958), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

- Delete/Remove actions across admin pages, project members, projects list, access tokens, and SSH keys now consistently display in red. ([#986](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/986), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

- Fixed the project name link font size in the Projects table to match the rest of the table text. ([#987](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/987), [@linghaoSu](https://github.com/linghaoSu))

- Fixed an issue where updating a robot account could unintentionally disable it. The robot’s enabled status is now preserved unless explicitly changed. ([#993](https://github.com/matrixhub-ai/matrixhub/pull/993), [@setsunakute](https://github.com/setsunakute))
